title: A set a.e. forward-invariant under the half-space of translations {⟨a,v⟩ ≥ 0} is null, co-null, or a half-space
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, F ⊆ ℝⁿ a Borel set and v ∈ ℝⁿ. Suppose that for every a ∈ ℝⁿ with ⟨a, v⟩ ≥ 0, for Lⁿ-almost every z ∈ ℝⁿ, z ∈ F implies z + a ∈ F. Then Lⁿ(F) = 0, or Lⁿ(ℝⁿ ∖ F) = 0, or there is c ∈ ℝ with Lⁿ(F Δ {z : ⟨z, v⟩ > c}) = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (F : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)), MeasurableSet F → (∀ a : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), 0 ≤ inner ℝ a v → ∀ᵐ z ∂volume, z ∈ F → z + a ∈ F) → volume F = 0 ∨ volume Fᶜ = 0 ∨ ∃ c : ℝ, volume (symmDiff F {z | c < inner ℝ z v}) = 0
